items.text: Its immigration critic said the party's amendments to the law barring hearings for late asylum claims would have kept hearings for those claims, protected survivors of gender-based violence and unaccompanied minors, and required parliamentary oversight of the power to cancel documents and applications in bulk.
Its new leader pledged to repeal the law barring hearings for late asylum claims and to move to a single-tier system giving permanent residence on arrival.
